马克斯与街角小店的计划(Max and the the corner store: 一篇关于城市生活的A2短文:马克斯与凯特的经历和小计划。
Max and Kate had great fun there. Life is full of small surprises. There are always many people at the corner store. Best of all, everyone in the class passed.
Kate's birthday is in January. Kate is interested in reading. Max wrote about the day in the diary. For example, the vase was damaged in transit.
Max likes sunny days best. They took many photos at the corner store. The riverside walk is one of the best places in the city. Factories that pollute the river must pay heavy fines.
Max is going to travel to Rome in January. Max hopes to visit Rome one day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the riverside walk by bike.
